checks.name: W24 Termination Date note vs specs and Form 220 casilla 31
checks.evidence: CO-DIAN-001 'Nomina Electronica Spec' row 79 (NIE003 FechaRetiro): 'Contract.End_Date (termination date of the system 'Termination' record)'. CO-PILA-003 row 156 (T2R2-081): same mapping. CO-DIAN-004 'Formulario 220 Spec' row 21 (casilla 31): 'PayPeriod.Year_End, or Contract.End_Date (system 'Termination' record) where the employee left during the year'; Population Rules row 5: casilla 31 = 31 December or the termination date, whichever is earlier. Official Form 220 instructions (Formulario_220_CertificadoIngresosRetenciones.pdf, 2023+ layout with casillas 38/58/59, Res. DIAN 000022/2024): '31. Período de la certificación, A: escriba en su orden el año, mes, día, en que termina el período que se certifica.' So the termination date is the value of casilla 31 for a leaver. The phrase 'closes the certification period of Form 220 casilla 31' is correct in substance but slightly loose (casilla 31 IS the end date of the certified period, not a period that is closed). Exact wording suggested: 'for a leaver who left during the year it is also the value of Form 220 casilla 31 "Período de la certificación, A" (end of the certified period) (CO-DIAN-004).'
